subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require Telegram-visible owner-session delivery proof before merge, or is source-level proof enough for this specific session-routing fix?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the changed behavior is user-visible message/session delivery and the PR itself says live Telegram proof is still pending.

options.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Delivery Risk
options.body: Maintainers can merge with source and regression-test evidence only, but then own the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops the completion.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: If maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths, pause this PR and fold the useful tests into that design.

recommendation.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across subagent completion delivery and the session/runtime boundary affected by the proof decision.
